known_limitations: Synthetic action candidates do not establish real-world feasibility.
A target model prediction does not guarantee a future lending outcome.
The finite enumerator is not the official implementation of any cited research software.
linked_change_treatment: Every linked downstream change is declared and evaluated inside the complete candidate feature state.
randomness_policy: The finite enumerator is deterministic and uses no random sampling.
single_feature_action_treatment: A single-feature result has exactly one declared primary action feature; linked downstream changes remain part of its state.
source_citations: Cheon, Wernerfelt, Friedler, and Ustun (2025), Feature Responsiveness Scores: Model-Agnostic Explanations for Recourse.
target_outcome_interpretation: The configured synthetic provider returns its target prediction for an evaluated declared state.
